ASSET: Sweet Home 3D / Scopia "Hedge (textured)" (hedgeTextured) - clipped box hedge block + seamless hedge-leaf texture
CATEGORY: vegetation -> hedge mesh (1.53 x 0.59 x 1.0 m block) and M_Hedge texture: hedge-displacement-texture.jpg
          (512x512, tiles seamlessly - checked 2x2) for palette M_Hedge (opaque, "Leaves" detail).
